near_floor_definition: both R and X <= 1.01e-6 pu (one percent above numerical floor); either-near is separately recorded
conclusions: Actual lower/upper limiting pairs are calculated from saved explanations; they need not be the same pair.
A small pair upper bounds the full minimum proxy score; this does not prove a complete-AC distance upper bound.
Near-zero internal coefficients provide near-equivalence evidence only within the recorded fitted/explanatory model.
Outer nuisance relaxation, missing history/noncontrol curvature and local H/AC fitting can also affect the score; no unique cause is established.
Saved full-AC attained scores are feasible-cost diagnostics; their difference from a proxy value is not a global AC optimality gap.
independent_H_unit: eight base histories; each has two paired quality conditions
